rules: OutboxSnapshot must come from acknowledged begin_outbox_delivery under the exact scoped JournalBinding and expected local CAS, with state DELIVERY_FENCED. Snapshot type/fields alone are not proof; trusted boundary binds it to the acknowledged current journal claim/fence.

Require current registered worker_ref and claim_ref, exact positive fence_version, delivery_ref and journal_revision from that acknowledged fence; lease_until must still be valid under admitted operational clock/configuration. Expired lease or stale claim rejects send, preserves fence/uncertainty and never permits reclaim/redelivery.

Bind descriptor.command_ref/outbox_ref/causation/dedupe identity to original scoped command and immutable target_binding_ref/payload_ref/payload_sha256. Resolve protected content/recipient/channel through the already registered qualified target, never caller input or a journal raw recipient.

Existing VerifiedAuthority and VerifiedCurrentness are produced by qualified current OP09/source admission, not caller assertions. Both bind the exact current AdmissionBinding/request digest/authorization to this original journal command; enforce principal/task/tenant/legal entity/purpose/source policy and admitted sender/recipient/window/content revisions.

After every awaited journal/custody/source step recheck the same private authorized lease/currentness before transport and disclosure. Missing/expired/revoked/erased evidence or sender/channel publication refuses without erasing source fact or resetting delivery fence.

Transport acknowledgement must yield independently verified OutboxAckEvidence bound to original outbox/delivery/target/payload; only then record_outbox_ack may mark ACK_RECORDED. No arbitrary tuple/HTTP ACK can fabricate this evidence.

DeliveryEvidenceReceipt remains an existing independently parsed/verified OP09 source result. ACK_RECORDED, an OutboxAckEvidence or tuple field presence never proves domain delivery/business completion; absence stays unknown and post-fence recovery is contracted lookup only.

A tuple with no independently verified acknowledgement and no source delivery evidence is inconclusive: retain/mark post-fence uncertainty, never ACK_RECORDED or completed. A delivery receipt with absent transport ACK preserves the genuine source fact but does not manufacture an outbox ACK.
